title: MES Mesh 0.1 — vocabulary (spec/profiles/mesh.md §2)
description: The parameter names and shapes Mesh descriptors MUST use for these concepts. A descriptor MAY narrow them (a smaller enum, a tighter range).

seed.description: Repeatability (§1.14). Absent: the engine picks one and reports it.

resolution.description: generate: the model's working resolution, overriding what quality picks within the offer (§3.1). Gate: supports.resolutions.

max_faces.description: generate: the most triangles the result may have (§1.9). Absent: the offer's default.

texture.description: generate: a texture atlas, or colour per vertex (§1.5). Gate: supports.textures.

texture_size.description: generate: the atlas's side in pixels. Gate: supports.texture_sizes. Only with texture: atlas.

background.description: generate: cut the object out of an opaque image first, or use the whole image (§3.1). remove gates supports.background_removal.

size_m.description: The object's longest extent in metres (§1.4).

skeleton.description: rig: a registered skeleton template (§3.2), or an x-<vendor>.<name> one. Absent: the model's own. Gate: supports.skeletons.

vrm_humanoid_joints.description: vrm_humanoid: VRM's humanoid bones as VRoid names them, rooted at J_Bip_C_Hips (§3.2).
